steps.text: Hui-chieh:
We have been heading south.
The guerrillas are hoping to get to as many mines as possible before the extermination plan gets underway to save as many Infected as we can.
The garrison is falling back, and we are pushing further and further ahead.
To outsiders, it probably looks like we are hunting down the Ursus squads. That couldn't be further from the truth, and it's a nigh impossible task.
We are hiding from the Ursus Army while also trying to save the Infected from under their nose.
If you ask me why we are doing this, I guess all I can tell you is, 'It's what we are supposed to do.'
That being said, I can't help but feel that by taking in all these Infected, thus giving the other teams some breathing room, we may be playing into Mr. Patriot's hand.
Patriot might have drawn a line. A line that we dare not to cross.
To cross that line is to fight the Ursus garrison head-on—a tall order, it goes without saying. It's either that or keeping ourselves under the radar.
In other words, we'll have to leave the tundra, and that means infiltrating the real Ursus territory—their nomadic cities, where all aspects of life are ruled with their iron fist.
At that point, the guerrillas put their weapons away until it's time for us to take up arms again.
The treatment of the Infected in the cities and ships out in the wild are bound to be even more cruel. I imagine the days that are to come will be very difficult.
It's not easy to take this step.
But this is the Northwestern Tundra... There's nothing but snow here.
We can't feed all these mouths with just snow.
November 3rd
Year X

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: My brothers and sisters, are you okay?!

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: It's good to see all of you in one piece.

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: ...Man, was that battle not a disaster.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Thank you, Yeti Squad. It's a pleasure to lead the fight with all of you.

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: The pleasure is ours, Talulah. We all think it's very reassuring to fight alongside you. We make a good match. Now I can see why FrostNova trusted you to lead our squad.

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: What's more, the way you use your Arts is getting more ingenious by the day. Blasting flames through the cold air, and detonating that? I don't think I could've come up with that one.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Well... those weren't exactly flames. It's hard to explain, so I'll spare you the details.

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: I'm sure FrostNova can rest easy knowing she doesn't have to look out for us all the time anymore.

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: So, do you think we'll come across any more of those Ursus scum here?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Well, this is one of the cities Ursus was planning on dismantling three years ago.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The troops here managed to take over the city, probably thanks to corruption or some equally dirty work... As for the original residents... probably either enslaved or driven out.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: They didn't stand a chance against us, at the very least.

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: They aren't as weak as you're making them out to be.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Just relatively speaking. Compared to the regular Ursus Army, at least. It's not like Patriot has let you fight any battles that difficult.

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: No, he hasn't. It's true. He didn't think we could handle it. But I think we are more than up to the task now, with how well we're getting on.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm not so sure about that. The real Ursus Army is on a whole other level. This detachment lacks discipline and training... I'm guessing they might not even be technically organized.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And we just barely had a leg up over these guys because of our tactical planning.

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: ...So you're saying we've got nothing to celebrate?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No, far from it. We have all the resources we need to survive now.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We really needed these supplies. Without them, we won't make it through the winter.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Besides, the nomadic city may be old and run-down, maybe even too small, but...

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: It's big enough for us.

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: None of us have ever been on a nomadic city before.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Talulah!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You're... one of the Infected from the Earcurl village... if my memory serves me correctly.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: We've got a pretty big team ourselves! At the very least, we're no smaller than you guerrillas.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Well, you're almost there. I'm not exactly part of the guerrilla force.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: We still definitely had more men in this fight than you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...So? What do you want from me?

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Let's go our own ways here, Talulah.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You serious?

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: We've fought plenty of battles with you people, and we've taken the shirt off our backs for you way more than I can count.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: You can take half of the resources in the city. Hell, take more than that.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Just let us keep the city.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: With the city... we could go anywhere. We could be anywhere in the tundra. The Patrol Unit and the Ursus troops will never find us.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: So you are saying you don't want to fight anymore?

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: We'll die.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: We're... We're all a little...

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: The enemy... They're getting stronger and stronger.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: These people aren't even on the same level as any of the contingents that Patriot's guerrilla squads have faced.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: But we can't do it!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Talulah, you aren't going to deny us even this, are you?

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: Okay, what are you people talking about now?

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: The Yeti...!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: ...You coldhearted monsters wouldn't understand! Death means nothing to you, not like the rest of us...!

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Waves Petrova down)

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: Talulah...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We'll get the supplies out right away. The city is yours to keep.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: That's good to hear...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But I won't stand for any insult to our fighters. Apologize to the Yetis right now.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Ahem... Sorry.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: That will do, right?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Petrova, gather your men. We need to itemize the supplies.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Also, turn on the Ursus comms terminal we captured.)

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: (You don't mean...)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (They know Patriot's guerrilla squad isn't around.)

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Mr. Patriot? We were just about to rendezvous with you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You handed the city to those folks?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Looks like you got my message already.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: —What these people are doing is nothing short of betrayal. Your permission has given them the justification they wanted. You destroyed the order here.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The moment they asked to be let go, I wasn't going to be able to keep them.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Those who lack conviction and willpower shouldn't wage war. Not now, not ever.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If we go by your logic, no one was born with the right to set foot on the battlefield in the first place.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Discipline is everything.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Kill them, and take the city back. You owe your team and your people this.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: So that they know the Infected will kill a bunch of helpless people with their backs against the wall and grease the wheels with their blood, all for a run-down city?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: They have contravened our discipline.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: None ever fought for discipline to begin with.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: It has been four years since we first met. In all this time, not once have I given you an order. I either tolerated your presence there on the battlefield or refused to work with you.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I really can't know if you have matured or gone soft in that time.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: All because I don't agree with you?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Summon the rest of the Infected and tell them they've betrayed the manifesto. Have them executed immediately.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You must make an example of their transgression.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I can't do that.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I can see you are hesitating. You are hesitating because they, too, are Infected.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Is it because you think this is dishonorable?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You loathe killing, and you don't care for power. That's not a bad thing. But then you need someone to do the dirty work for you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'll let you know I'm not afraid of doing this, and I don't dare to claim I have the moral high ground over anyone either.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: In that case, the guerrillas and I will get it done.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If you refuse to take up arms against them, the guerrillas will clean up the mess.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: What is that expression? You can't possibly think I am the honest and noble man everyone makes me out to be?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Someone like that would've been dead long before the fighting even began.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: What's honorable besides reigning victorious and safeguarding the fruits of victory? Triumphing over the enemies you loathe in battle is by its very nature an honor, but that doesn't mean I take pride in my sacrifices.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If a decision leads to victory and fewer dead comrades, then that's the right decision to make.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: This city is already on its last legs. It's likely been in service for much longer than it was intended. It's not going to last another three years.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Both you and I know that they are doomed to be stranded in the tundra. They'll still have to find a way out in the end. But, with the city, they bought themselves a tiny bit of hope, even if it's just for those three years.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm not going to crush that hope of theirs.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You're fine seeing your team get torn into two?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No. I already told you... they were never on the same team as us to begin with.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm not going to give you the 'the weak cannot go to battle' excuse you've been giving me. All I'm saying is not everyone thinks the same way we do.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We'll have many people join our ranks. But not all of them are working towards the same goal as we are.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We're just borrowing their strength. We aren't exploiting it. If we forced them to do our bidding, we would only be making them work against their own goals.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And that's how you get them to actually start doubting each other and feel alienated.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: All for the sake of unit purity, is it?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If that's what you want to call it. I'm not sure I'd describe it like that, though.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: If nothing else, I can tell you are a righteous person.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: There's a unit stationed nearby guarding the trade route, and they're much better trained. You know things are bound to go wrong.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I don't want to admit it, but you're right. They just might do that, so we'll prepare for that.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The Yetis... intercepted the message already.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You're right. The nomadic city sent a message out. They tipped off the Ursus troops in the area our location.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...They want to draw the Ursus Army's attention to us.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No one wanted this battle to happen.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Their foolishness will slowly lead them to destruction.
